problem:
The equation of the hyperbola $45{x}^{2}-5{y}^{2}=135$ in standard form is{{field-1}}
$=1.$
worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a horizontal hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $135$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}45{x}^{2}-5{y}^{2} & =135 \\ \frac{45{x}^{2}}{135}-\frac{5{y}^{2}}{135} & =\frac{135}{135} \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{3}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{27} & =1\end{aligned}
$$
